input: Enroll my kid in a weekend science camp

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The child's age and grade level determines which camps they are eligible for and what content is age-appropriate.
Knowing whether a specific science topic is preferred (robotics, chemistry, biology, space, etc.) narrows the search to relevant camps.
The location or region determines which camps are geographically accessible, whether in-person or online.
Budget limits which programs are viable, since camp costs vary widely from free community programs to expensive private ones.
The target start date or weekend affects urgency, registration deadlines, and which upcoming sessions are still open.
Whether the camp should be drop-off, overnight, or virtual affects the type of programs to look for and logistics for the parent.
Understanding what the parent values most — fun, academic rigor, credentials, social experience — determines how to evaluate and compare options.

gold.taskTitle: Enroll kid in a weekend science camp
gold.taskDescription: Find and complete enrollment for a child in a weekend science camp that fits their age, interests, and schedule.

questions.title: How old is your child, and what grade are they in?
questions.description: The child's age and grade determine eligibility for specific camp programs and appropriate content level.

questions.title: Is there a specific science topic they are interested in?
questions.description: Knowing a preferred focus — such as robotics, chemistry, space, or nature — narrows the search to relevant camps.

questions.title: What city or region should the camp be located in?
questions.description: Location determines which in-person programs are geographically reachable, or whether a fully online option is preferred.

questions.title: What is your budget per weekend session or program?
questions.description: Camp costs range from free to several hundred dollars; knowing the budget filters out programs that are not financially viable.

questions.title: When do you want the camp to start?
questions.description: The target start date drives urgency, surfaces open registration windows, and identifies which upcoming sessions are available.

questions.title: Should the camp be drop-off, residential, or fully virtual?
questions.description: The format — drop-off day camp, overnight stay, or online — fundamentally shapes which programs to consider.

questions.title: What matters most to you in a great camp experience?
questions.description: Priorities such as hands-on fun, academic rigor, certified instructors, or strong peer social environment determine how to rank and compare options.
